findings.claim: DoorDash 10-K（FY2025）風險因子僅一般性提及國際擴張涉及出口管制與貿易制裁（OFAC、歐盟）合規風險，未點名關稅或實體清單對其產品／供應鏈的具體暴露。
findings.excerpt: international expansion may subject our business to broader economic, political, and other international risks, including economic volatility, security risks, and geopolitical conflicts, and may increase our risks in complying with various laws and standards, including with respect to anti-corruption, anti-bribery, export controls, and trade and economic sanctions, such as U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control sanctions and similar European Union ("EU") sanctions.

findings.claim: 分析師文章（非公司揭露）稱 2026 年主要逆風為全球關稅，美國有效關稅率 13-17%，壓抑可自由支配支出。
findings.source: Finterra／FinancialContent：The New Era of Local Commerce: A Deep Dive into DoorDash (DASH) and the Global Tariff Shock
findings.excerpt: The primary headwind in 2026 is the impact of global tariffs. With effective US tariff rates reaching 13-17% following recent trade disputes, the "discretionary dollar" is under pressure.

note: 搜尋未找到 DoorDash 被 Section 232 涵蓋或列入實體清單的來源；僅 2 次搜尋，其餘查詢未執行。
